_comment: Maps source PNGs in tools/assets-src/ to atlas keys for buildAtlas.mjs. Keys: z:{zone}:{bucket}:{variant} (zone 1=R 2=C 3=I, bucket 0=low 1=mid 2=high) or b:{building} (Building enum). anchorX/anchorY = pixel in the SOURCE image sitting on the plot's NORTH apex (origin tile top). tilePx = px-per-tile the art was drawn at (omit if 64). Delete this _comment key in real use. The entries below are illustrative placeholders for a Kenney-style pack.
